title: Weekly ad review
goal: Read the last seven days of the ad accounts for venture {venture} and write a review with recommendations; change nothing.

steps.title: Read the accounts and write the review
steps.brief: Read every campaign, ad set / ad group and the last seven days of results with meta_ads.campaigns, meta_ads.insights, google_ads.campaigns and google_ads.metrics (whichever are connected; say which are not). Write outbox/ads/review-{venture}.md: a table of spend, clicks, impressions and results per campaign, then three recommendations each tied to a number in the table (pause, raise or lower a budget, a new creative). Do not change any budget or status: recommendations only. Figures come only from the connector reads; where a connector is not connected write "no data".
